extra_sanitizers.justification: added from code evidence; not present in the CSVs

entry.rationale: uuid.UUID(conceptid) validation guard in get_child_edges: non-UUID conceptid values short-circuit the function (except -> return []), and a valid UUID contains only hex digits and dashes - it cannot carry quote-breaking SQL payloads. Neutralizes the conceptid slot of the SQL assembled at :653/:713 for all callers (concept() view route param, paged_dropdown conceptid, concept-search removechildren). NOTE: this guard does NOT cover the `query` parameter of the same function (interpolated at :635/:646) nor get_e55_domain's conceptid (models/concept.py:1180) - those remain confirmed sinks.
